assistant.title: AI Console
assistant.subtitle: Say it in plain words: research, render tasks, drafts and publishing are all handled here, with every step reported back.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Look up the latest news about brand X and make a 30s vertical short
assistant.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

empty.title: Start from a goal
empty.description: Describe the outcome; it breaks the work into steps. Pick a line below, tweak it, then send.

prompts.news: Look up the latest news about brand X and make a 30s vertical short
prompts.tweak: Make the subtitles on that last cut bigger and use a calmer voice-over
prompts.publish: Then publish it to Douyin and Xiaohongshu

error.unavailable: The console backend is not ready yet (no response or 404). It will work once the endpoints ship; other panels are unaffected.
error.emptyReply: The console returned nothing. Please send it again.

factCard.title: One-click fact card
factCard.subtitle: Pick a topic and points, submit once, and get a vertical fact card; the draft lands in the Jianying draft box automatically, no manual import.
factCard.hookPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. When VRAM runs out, the model lives on it
factCard.pointPlaceholder: Store only K and V::because Q is used once for this step
factCard.pointsHint: Write each point as "title::detail" with a double colon; cards are rendered in the order you enter them.
factCard.voiceHint: Voice-over is synthesized on the worker host; female by default.
factCard.kickerHint: Shown at the top-left of each card; defaults to 大模型面试题.
factCard.submitHint: The worker renders each card and voice-over; the draft reaches Jianying within a minute.
factCard.draftHint: The draft appears in the Jianying draft box automatically; no manual import needed.

error.pointFormat: Point {{index}} must use the "title::detail" format (double colon)
error.noProject: No production project yet. Create a project before rendering.
